changelog:
Initial release of offline voice-to-text skill with Vosk.

- Converts audio files (.wav) to text using the Vosk local model.
- Usage via `main.py` with `run(params)` interface.
- Simple input/output: provide audio path, receive text transcript.
- Includes installation and usage examples.
- Depends on `vosk` and `pytest`.
summary: Offline speech-to-text conversion using Vosk local model; input audio file path, output transcript text.
